description: Tabs the user saved in the SpyWinAds app (saved filters over the videos their own keyword scans found in the last 30 days, e.g. 'Few stores, long-running'): id, name and filters. Read a tab's videos with spywin_list_my_videos(custom_tab_id=id).
name: spywin_list_my_custom_tabs
title: My saved tabs
